compatibilityReview.reviewer: DOC-030 independent walkthrough and compatibility reviewer agents (one seat per article group, independent of the source-review authors)
compatibilityReview.summary: DOC-030 (#1157) re-verifies the suite against labs built from 067c1646. Each guide whose text or underlying behavior changed received a source review, then an independent agent walkthrough for every required role and method on that build. Guides the app-diff triage left unchanged carry a compatibility review with replayed DOC-029 scripts. This summary is provisional until the batch closes; articles without passing evidence receive no credit.
